page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Auriacus" (the word after Guilhelmus tertius is hard to make out; marked [?]). "imposterum" read from a worn word that looks like "imposterum". The "Passaviensi" and "Protestantibus" forms are read as printed. Line 3 of the last paragraph ends "Mona-" and continues on the next page ("sterien-" catchword). Running head "CAP. III: 14-19." is printed at the left top and taken as part of the running head.
